datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework across Mozambique. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications were compiled into spatial datasets with scenario variations, representing population-level food security status as a loss indicator derived from underlying hazards and livelihood disruptions.
